cardOverview.overviewText: A corporate Premium card with elevated privileges for large enterprises, providing enhanced expense tracking, global acceptance, and business-related benefits.

benefitRows.name: Corporate Liability Waiver
benefitRows.offer: Get corporate liability waiver insurance to protect against the risk of employee fraud with a card-level cover of ₹2,00,000 and corporate-level cover of ₹25,00,000.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Contact the bank customer care for more details.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: Road/Rail Accident : Cover of INR 3Lacs available to primary card holder.|Accidental hospitalization cover : Cover of upto INR 25000 available to primary card holder.|Credit shield cover : Cover of upto INR 5 Lacs is available to primary card holder.|Delay in flights : Cover of INR 15,000 on domestic flights and USD 200 on international flights is available to the primary card holder.|loss of checked baggage : Cover of upto INR 10000 on domestic flights and USD 200 on International flights available to the primary card holder on loss of one or more baggage’s checked in by the card holder.|Loss of personal documents : Cover of upto INR 25,000 for Loss of Passport/Visa and International flights upto USD 325 available to the primary card holder.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Avail Insurance package starting at an annual premium of Rs.3,785 which includes the above.
